title: Full Day Seward Tour
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the captivating beauty of Seward on this full-day adventure. With expert local guides, explore Alaska's stunning landscapes, including majestic glaciers, coastal views, and charming towns. Witness the breathtaking sights at Mount Alyeska, and enjoy a scenic walk along Portage Lake. An unforgettable BBQ experience awaits in summer, featuring local salmon if the weather permits. Tailored for small groups, this tour provides a personalized exploration of Seward's culture and history.

- 12-hour guided tour showcasing Alaska's natural beauty
- Scenic stops at Beluga Point and Mount Alyeska with tram access
- Opportunity to hike to Byron Glacier and explore ice caves
- Includes a chance to enjoy a BBQ with local salmon in summer
